gates: Use immutable GitHub user IDs for official Store replies.
Suppress only an official Store reply that occurs after the latest author comment; keep later author requests eligible for review.
Cover owner, Actions bot and unrelated commenter cases with disposable fixtures.
npm run check passes before the CI-checked PR.
No third-party source or runtime code is executed.
commitStrategy: Create one atomic commit from the exact base and open a CI-checked pull request using the connected short-lived GitHub credential.
rollback: Revert only this commit through Git history; no contact reservations or Catalog state are modified.
purpose: Prevent answered author comments from reappearing as new feedback while preserving later explicit author requests.
